name: Jamiphy
long_description:
Jamiphy is the destination for live music. All you have to do is watch, engage with what you like, skip what you don't, and you'll find an endless stream of live music that feels personalized just for you.

We make it easy for you to discover and create your own live music videos by providing easy-to-use tools to view and capture your greatest musical moments. Take your videos to the next level with Jamiphy!

founders.title: Founder/Lead Software Engineer
founders.founder_bio: I’m looking for a remote senior or lead engineering role where I can own meaningful product work across TypeScript, Python, mobile, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, ideally on a small, high-output team, and I’d like to avoid narrow maintenance-only roles, heavy bureaucracy, or environments where engineers are disconnected from product and customer outcomes.
